splits.name: locked_retrospective_test
splits.usage: one evaluation per immutable challenger version; never used for tuning

primary_metric.name: paired_point_process_information_gain_per_earthquake
primary_metric.aggregation: sum challenger log score minus ETAS log score, divided by target event count

required_reports: ETAS and challenger expected event counts
number, spatial, pseudolikelihood, and magnitude consistency tests
information gain for M>=3.5 and M>=4.0 target events
information gain in the low-ETAS-intensity stratum

low_etas_intensity_stratum.definition: target events whose pre-event frozen ETAS intensity is at or below the challenger-fit event-intensity 25th percentile
low_etas_intensity_stratum.threshold_lock: must be committed in the challenger training manifest before validation scoring

retrospective_research_win: primary information gain is positive on development validation
locked retrospective 95% 30-day block-bootstrap lower bound is greater than zero
locked retrospective 90-day sensitivity lower bound is not negative
all required calibration and magnitude-stratified results are reported
scientific_superiority_claim: predictions are persisted before target catalog ingestion
prospective evaluation spans at least 365 issue days and at least 500 M>=2.5 target events
prospective 95% 30-day block-bootstrap lower bound is greater than zero
no challenger parameter or feature definition changes after prospective activation

prospective.activation_rule: commit the first issue time and challenger artifact hashes before its target window begins

claim_boundary: The locked retrospective test is as-of-snapshot evidence and is not a blind prospective record because historical catalog revisions and prior Automata research may have influenced model design.
